_comment: Maps the column names of a source CSV to ours. Keys = OUR names, values = THEIR column header. Delete a key you do not have. 'extra:<nutrient>' columns (per 100 g) go to the flexible 'extra' list. 'groups' = 'Group:portion_g;Group:portion_g'. 'tags' = 'tag;tag'. 'fdc_id' = the USDA FoodData Central id (a row keeps its identity by it). 'portions' = 'cup:172;large:50' (label:grams).
name: name
